2608.27785.title: Compositional Failure in Audio-Visual LLMs: Late-Layer Prior Dominance Under Cross-modal Conflict
2608.27785.paper_summary: We study audio-visual conflict as a compositional generalization test for AV-LLMs: the model must combine synchronized but semantically incompatible audio and video evidence and decide whether the pair matches. On VideoLLaMA 2-7B-AV, three alignment configurations remain nearchance on the scored exact-string Yes/No subset of AVHBench, even though their output priors shift substantially. Similarly, off-the-shelf InternVideo2 experienced a 32.3% accuracy decrease specifically under cross-modal conflict, accompanied by a 17.3% instruction-following failure. We call this failure mode prior dominance: late-layer commitment to an internally preferred answer pattern that is weakly grounded in the conflicting inputs. To explain this behavior, we conduct a mechanistic interpretability analysis and find that commitment remains concentrated at 25.5 $\pm$ 1 layers. We show that stronger temporal alignment changes answer bias, but do not improve compositional conflict resolution. Code and data to reproduce our mechanistic audit and behavioral evaluations are available at https://github.com/AdarshSudheer09/AVHBench-dmai.
2608.27785.paper_summary_zh: 我們研究音視覺衝突作為AV-LLMs的組合概括測試：模型必須結合同步但語義不相容的音頻和視頻證據，並決定這對是否匹配。 在VideoLLaMA 2-7B-AV上，三種對齊配置在AVHBench的精確字符串是/否子集上仍然接近隨機，儘管它們的輸出先驗有顯著變化。 類似地，現成的InternVideo2在跨模態衝突下經歷了32.3%的準確率下降，伴隨著17.3%的遵循指令失敗。 我們稱這種失敗模式為先驗主導：對內部偏好的答案模式的晚層承諾，這種模式在衝突輸入中基礎薄弱。 為了解釋這種行為，我們進行了機械可解釋性分析，發現承諾仍然集中在25.5 $\pm$ 1層。 我們表明，較強的時間對齊改變了答案偏見，但並未改善組合衝突的解決。 用於重現我們的機械審計和行為評估的代碼和數據可在 https://github.com/AdarshSudheer09/AVHBench-dmai 獲得。
